ask: TypeScript, Node 22, no express. server.ts: typed mini framework — router with method+path patterns, param extraction, JSON body parsing with size limit, schema validation helpers, error middleware, 404 and 500 handling, in-memory store for a todo resource with CRUD routes, and graceful shutdown. compile clean under strict. write the file.
prose:
`server.ts` is written. Run it with:

```bash
npx tsc --strict server.ts --module nodenext --moduleresolution nodenext --target es2022 --outdir dist
node dist/server.js
```

Or drop a `tsconfig.json` if you want a cleaner build. The endpoints are:

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/todos` | list, sorted by creation |
| GET | `/todos/:id` | 404 if missing |
| POST | `/todos` | `{ title }` required, 1–500 chars |
| PATCH | `/todos/:id` | `title` and/or `completed`, extra fields rejected |
| DELETE | `/todos/:id` | 204 on success |

Body size is capped at 100 KB. SIGTERM/SIGINT drain existing connections before exit, with a 10 s hard timeout.
